Capital Returns Management Llc who had been investing in Emc Ins Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $552.97 million market cap company. (NASDAQ:EMCI) has declined 5.33% since May 31, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.90% the S&P500.
